description: A World of Tanks-style armored combat simulator built directly with Three.js and Vite: 220 vehicles, 33 destructible battlefields, and 13 modes, with plate-level armor, ballistics, modules, spotting, and physics. Play in your browser on desktop or mobile. Built end-to-end by a multi-agent Claude/Codex pipeline.
